press_references.value: Animoca Brands and HKSTP to Host Demo Day for Agentic AI Startups

partnership_announcements.description: Animoca Brands and Hong Kong Science and Technology Parks Corporation are partnering to co-host the Build East demo day for agentic AI startups in Hong Kong, offering access to up to US$10 million via the Minds Investment Programme and ecosystem support.

overview_description.description: Animoca Brands is a metaverse and gaming venture capital firm that focuses on driving digital property rights to gamers and internet users through NFTs. It utilizes gamification and blockchain to develop and market a portfolio of mobile applications, games, and additional products oriented to educational learning to ensure transparency, security, and new business models.

product.name: Digital Asset Services
product.description: Advisory and operational services for Web3 projects, including token strategy, research, marketing, partnerships, liquidity provisioning, and blockchain node operations.

product.name: Moca Network
product.description: A consumer-focused Web3 network providing digital identity, rewards, and interoperability services for users and applications across gaming, culture, and online communities.

product.name: The Sandbox
product.description: A blockchain-based virtual world and creator platform where users and brands can build, publish, experience, and monetize interactive 3D environments and digital assets.

product.name: Open Campus
product.description: A blockchain-based education platform for issuing, managing, and using verifiable academic credentials and education-related digital assets.

product.name: Institutional Treasury Management
product.description: Digital-asset treasury management for institutions, covering risk diversification, staking, arbitrage, options, token investments, OTC lending, and hedging.

product.name: Anchorpoint Financial
product.description: An institutional stablecoin and real-world-asset business focused on connecting traditional finance with blockchain-based financial products and infrastructure.
